description: Run the AI-DLC `build-and-test` stage (construction phase) in isolation, without advancing the main workflow. Packages `/aidlc --stage build-and-test --single`: the engine emits one run-stage directive for build-and-test and its gate, the conductor runs it, then the single-stage run commits a synthetic-id pair and stops. The main workflow's Current Stage is never touched.
